route_topologist.agent_description: Synthesizes Route 9 topological data, ledge directions, elevations, and collision boundaries to find the unblocked route from Cerulean City to Route 10.
route_topologist.agent_system_prompt: You are a master Pokémon Red/Blue route topologist. You analyze coordinate logs, elevations, ramps, ledges, and trainer positions to identify overlooked pathways and determine the correct traversal route.
route_topologist.agent_input_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"query": {"type": "string", "description": "Specific topological query or routing paradox to resolve."}}, "required": ["query"]}
route_topologist.agent_output_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"analysis": {"type": "string", "description": "Detailed topological analysis of the route geometry."}, "recommended_path": {"type": "string", "description": "Concrete step-by-step path to reach Route 10."}}, "required": ["analysis", "recommended_path"]}
